text.autoconfig.offhandshiftclick.title: Offhand Shift-Click
text.autoconfig.offhandshiftclick.option:
Deny list: every item goes to the off hand EXCEPT those on the deny list.
Allow list: ONLY items on the allow list go to the off hand.

Used in 'Everything except deny list' mode.
Examples:
minecraft:diamond
#minecraft:swords  (a tag)
modid:*  (every item from a mod)

Used in 'Only allow list' mode.
Examples:
minecraft:torch
#minecraft:swords  (a tag)
modid:*  (every item from a mod)
